title: Cinco de Mayo Casserole
description: This easy Cinco de Mayo recipe features ground beef, Mexican-style corn, sour cream, and Cheddar cheese baked into a creamy and hearty casserole.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon vegetable oil, or as needed
1 (10 ounce) can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers (such as RO*TEL®), drained

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add ground beef; cook and stir until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes; drain and discard grease. Transfer beef to a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Heat oil in the same skillet over medium heat. Add onion and garlic; cook and stir until onion is translucent, about 10 minutes. Spoon onion mixture over ground beef.
Stir 1 cup Cheddar cheese, tomatoes with green chile peppers, salsa, sour cream, corn, salt, and black pepper into ground beef mixture until well combined; top with remaining 2 cups Cheddar cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven until cooked through and cheese is melted, about 45 minutes. Let stand before serving, 10 minutes.
